title: Two-bit input from free coordinates
statement: For an assignment $y$ of signs to the two free coordinates, form the two-bit sign vector whose entries are the signs assigned to the first and second free coordinates, in that order.
hypotheses_covered: $y$ assigns a sign to each of the two free coordinates
